description: This file implements a server for nested RBUS objects, handling get requests and invoking remote methods. It sets up object registration, handles callbacks, and manages a nested call to another object.

methods.name: int handle_get(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage message,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Handles 'get' method calls, returns data, and makes a nested call if the destination matches the object name.

methods.name: void handle_unknown(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage message,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: Handles unknown methods by returning an unsupported method error.

methods.name: int callback(const char * destination,const char * method,rbusMessage message,void * user_data,rbusMessage * response,const rtMessageHeader * hdr)
methods.description: General callback invoked upon message receipt, logs the message, and calls handle_unknown.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Entry point, initializes connection, registers objects and method tables, and waits indefinitely.
